title: Secure Coding Techniques Missions
subtitle: Five configurable missions that help engineers recognize, remediate and verify secure coding decisions before code reaches guests.

scenarios.title: Order Lookup: Validate and Parameterize
scenarios.summary: Review an order lookup endpoint, replace unsafe query construction and catch the same pattern in a helper.

scenarios.title: Guest Welcome: Render Data Safely
scenarios.summary: Review browser rendering code, choose an output-safe correction and find an XSS regression in a second component.

scenarios.title: Order Access: Enforce the Server Boundary
scenarios.summary: Replace client-controlled access checks with least-privilege server controls and harden the session cookie.

scenarios.title: Payment Failure: Debug Without Disclosure
scenarios.summary: Protect the user-facing error path, remove sensitive log content and recover from a plausible partial fix.

scenarios.title: AI Draft: Review Before You Merge
scenarios.summary: Apply the normal secure-review bar to an AI-generated order endpoint and preserve safe AI context controls.
